title: Nicely Smoked German Smoked Turkey Neck Pilaf
description: A spicy, crisp and adventurous German dish featuring smoked turkey neck, serving as a plant-based-friendly option. This recipe is best prepared using a tava-griddle.
instructions: Heat the tava-griddle over medium heat.
Cut the smoked turkey neck into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
Roll out the lamination-puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut the pastry into 4 equal pieces and set aside.
Chop the onion and saut it in a pan until translucent.
Add the garlic, chili flakes, paprika, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the vegan broth to the pan and bring to a boil.
Add the chopped onion and turkey neck to the pan and stir to combine.
Place one of the pastry pieces into the pan, pressing the edges to seal the filling inside.
Cook for 4-5 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Repeat the process with the remaining pastry pieces and filling.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
